description:
PROPOSE a teammate who should add keys for some providers. Nothing is sent: the proposal
waits in setup step 4, where the brand owner reviews it and sends the invite in the dashboard
(send_url). Calling again for the same email adds providers to that proposal.
Returns { proposed, email, providers, teammates, send_url }.

providers.description: Providers you want them to add a key for
